output.scope_note: The paper studies Li6PS5Cl solid electrolyte surfaces and reports computed room-temperature Li+ ionic conductivities (extrapolated from MLFF-MD) for surface and bulk regions.

records.material_as_written: Li6PS5Cl (LPSC) surface region after CO2 reaction, LPSC(100) slab
records.measurement_method: MLFF-based MD with MSD and Einstein relation, extrapolated to room temperature
records.evidence_quote: the extrapolated room-temperature ion conductivities of the surface and bulk regions are 1.27 × 10−3 S/m and 2.15 × 10−4 S/m, respectively.
records.notes: Value is for the surface region (top and bottom three Li layers) of the LPSC(100) slab after CO2 reaction, from MLFF-MD at 500-900 K extrapolated to 300 K; not an experimental measurement. Paper does not give an activation energy in text.

records.material_as_written: Li6PS5Cl (LPSC) bulk region of LPSC(100) slab
records.measurement_method: MLFF-based MD with MSD and Einstein relation, extrapolated to room temperature
records.evidence_quote: the extrapolated room-temperature ion conductivities of the surface and bulk regions are 1.27 × 10−3 S/m and 2.15 × 10−4 S/m, respectively.
records.notes: Value is for the bulk region (central seven Li layers) of the LPSC(100) supercell slab, from MLFF-MD at 500-900 K extrapolated to 300 K; not an experimental measurement.
